cohort: 500 pregnant women randomly selected based on availability of medical records
finding: The prevalence of preeclampsia was 6.2%, and preeclampsia with severe features was significantly associated with lower birth weight infants.
mod_finding: 48.38% of preeclamptic women delivered by cesarean section.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was documented in 48.4% of infants born to preeclamptic women.
